sections.heading: Ongoing Projects
sections.text: Caoyuan Ma* , Wendi Liu*, Wenqi Shao, Yinqiang Zheng * Equal contribution (co-first authors). A long-term benchmark connecting Isaac Sim robots with a real virtual machine. Models operate a keyboard and mouse through robotic actions to complete OSWorld tasks, with ongoing task and leaderboard updates. Project released October 12, 2026 (AoE). Full research code, assets, and an arXiv report are planned for release by the end of November 2026.

sections.heading: News
sections.text: October 12, 2026 (AoE) – We released the ROSWORLD project page, introducing a living benchmark for robotic computer use on OSWorld tasks. Full research code, assets, and an arXiv report are planned for release by the end of November. Link: ROSWORLD (https://miles629.github.io/ROSWORLD/) April 2026 – I left Shanghai AI Lab and joined JD Explore Institute to work on post-training for multimodal large language models, focusing on post-training performance improvement in specific domains. October 2025 – I am sponsored by Spring GX Scholarship. July 2025 – Two papers, in which I am co-author, were accepted to ACM MM. June 2025 – Two papers, in which I am co-first author, were accepted to ICCV. April 2025 – I accepted the invitation to serve as a reviewer for NeurIPS 2025. March 2025 – I led a large-scale data curation effort, implementing automated pipelines for data cleaning, video clip extraction and multi-modal annotations from massive datasets. February 2025 – My projects, TAAT and HumanNeRF-SE, were showcased during a segment on Hubei TV covering the visit of the then Hubei Provincial Party Secretary to inspect startup company 模态跃迁. February 2025 – I joined StepFUN, dedicated to completing a human-centric foundational model for video generation. I received a 2025 fall PhD position at University of Tokyo. January 2025 – I am working on a new project about human motion generation, new dataset and task will be released soon. Any form of collaboration is welcome! October 2024 – I submitted my PhD application to the Graduate School of Information Science and Technology at the University of Tokyo. June 2024 – I attended CVPR2024 in Seattle and I was invited to attend the Meshcapade dinner at June 19th by Yu Sun, it was a great week. May 2024 – Serve as an MM24 reviewer. April 2024 – I'm preparing for the ILETS test. I hope to get a 2025 fall PhD position in Singapore or Japan. Feel free to contact me if you have any chances or suggestions. April 2024 – My new research TAAT: Think and Act from Arbitrary Texts already has a preliminary version, which can generate motions with texts processed by LLMs. March 2024 – My first work HumanNeRF-SE was accepted by CVPR2024. June 2022 – Outstanding graduates of Wuhan University. October 2021 – National scholarship 国家奖学金 (the second time). (Award Rate: 0.2% nation-wide) Ministry of Education, China. October 2021 – First Class Scholarship (Award Rate: 5% school-wide) Wuhan University. October 2020 – National scholarship 国家奖学金. (Award Rate: 0.2% nation-wide) Ministry of Education, China. October 2020 – First Class Scholarship (Award Rate: 5% school-wide) Wuhan University.

sections.text: Caoyuan Ma µ +81 70 8488 2313 University of Tokyo å mcy@g.ecc.u-tokyo.ac.jp Graduate School of Information Science and Technology H GitHub: Miles 629 Ph.D. Student — Multimodal LLM Safety œ Google Scholar Education The University of Tokyo Oct. 2025 – Present Ph.D. in Information Science and Technology Research Focus: Multimodal LLM Safety Wuhan University, School of Computer Science Sep. 2022 – Jun. 2025 M.S. in Computer Science and Technology Human-centric AIGC and 3D Vision Wuhan University, School of Computer Science Sep. 2018 – Jul. 2022 B.Eng. in Software Engineering GPA: 3.87/4.00; top 1% in two academic years Research Interests Research Interests: Multimodal intelligence, with a focus on post-training, alignment, safety, and embodied spatial reasoning. ȅ Research portfolio Research and Industry Experience Multimodal Foundation Models JD Explore Academy — Research Intern Apr. 2026 – Present – Audited every sample across six benchmarks, categorized image and question patterns, and built targeted collection, cleaning, and multi-agent cross-validation pipelines that produced 7.74 million samples totaling 15.6 billion tokens. – Improved the average score of Qwen 3-VL-30B-A3B from 48.3 to 55.5; optimized the data mixture for the mainline model, enabling the specialist model to match top-tier 300B-model performance. – Built data for ZeroBench-main, improving the specialist model by approximately 10 points during SFT; developed CoT data collection pipelines for Claude Opus and Fable to support agent training. Shanghai AI Laboratory (Remote) — Research Intern Sep. 2025 – Apr. 2026 – Supported base-model experiments and evaluation for SafeWork-R1. – Independently studied semi-self-evolving LLM safety; manuscript in revision. Video Generation Hedra (U.S., Remote) — Research Intern 2025 – Selected and applied DMD and Self-Forcing to production video models, delaying noticeable visual degradation from approximately 8 to 30 seconds. StepFun — Research Intern 2025 – Led a four-person team to build a large-scale video-data curation pipeline for model training, processing more than 30 TB of video. 3D Human Reconstruction Noitom & JD Group — Research Intern 2022 – 2024 – Built a synchronized IMU motion-capture and multi-camera system to collect multi-view human motion data. – Developed a NeRF-based human-centric 6D reconstruction method spanning 3D space and 3D skeleton-driven motion, resulting in the ﬁrst-authored CVPR 2024 paper HumanNeRF-SE.
